Class ActiveAgent

java.lang.Object
base.NetworkNode
base.ActiveAgent
Direct Known Subclasses:
AntivirusSentinel, MalwareStrain, RepairBot
public abstract class ActiveAgent extends NetworkNode
Abstract class for nodes that can move independently across the grid. Each tick an agent first acts (scans and queues combat), then moves.

      public abstract void action(NetworkNode[][] grid, List<ActiveAgent> agents, SimulationConfig config, CombatResolver resolver)
      Act phase: scan from the current position, set currentTarget, and queue any damage or repair through the resolver. Does not move or change HP directly.

    • moveToward

      protected void moveToward(int targetRow, int targetCol, int maxRows, int maxCols)
      Steps one cell toward the given coordinates, staying inside the grid. Each axis moves on its own so the agent can slide along edges.

    • rollDamage

      protected int rollDamage(int baseDamage)
      Rolls a randomized damage amount around the given base (a spread of half the base). This keeps combat from being perfectly deterministic, so two evenly matched fighters won't always trade fatal blows on the same tick.
      Parameters:
      baseDamage - the agent's normal damage
      Returns:
      a damage value in the range [base - base/2, base + base/2]

    • randomWalk

      protected void randomWalk(int maxRows, int maxCols)
      Takes a single random step (-1, 0, or +1 per axis), staying inside the grid.
